why: The project's proposition_8_1_17_two_all assumes two hypotheses that B lacks, for every i. hR: HasConnectedDenseLevelOneReps (Xⁱ), natural representations with U(x) ∩ X₁ connected and dense (the text's V(x)). hp: the tangent projection p : T𝐗ⁱ → (𝐗ⁱ)¹ is open (Part I gap G.8). B is the text's claim with neither, so A_to_B fails. With them it is immediate (A_to_B_of_hyp). Both hypotheses are satisfiable (pointEP), so the difference is a genuine weakening of the claim, not vacuity. Closing it would need new mathematics, namely G.8 and the connectedness and density of V(x) for every ep-groupoid; glue would not do. B_to_A takes the main theorem from B (hR, hp unused) and the point witness from B with isSLUC_pointEP. The five auxiliary conjuncts B does not contain are re-proved from the non-item lemmas their proofs use: EpEquiv.nonEffectivePart_eq, EpEquiv.isLUC, isLUC_tangent_lift, the subsingleton witness, and Proposition 2.3.17 for all i.
overlap: B_to_A shares 1034 project theorems with the item's proofs. Nearly all come from the five re-proved auxiliary conjuncts, which follow the project's own proofs: 2021 Proposition 7.2.21, proposition_8_1_17_one with the tangent ep-groupoid and lift lemmas, Theorem 7.1, and the Proposition 2.3.17 sub-lemmas of TangentLiftAll.lean (tangentLiftEquiv_unique, incl_tangentLiftEquiv, …), down to the chart and retraction lemmas. The main conjunct itself comes from B.
